notes: large-jvm-module: the agent must implement a precisely-specified capability (an optional bounded-capacity mode on the coordinator event accumulator: reject RejectedExecutionException when full without state change, non-positive capacities rejected at construction, default constructor unbounded) inside the real apache/kafka 4.3.1 tree WITHOUT being told the module, class, or file; it must navigate 7,232 files, locate the concurrency primitive, and prove its work through Kafka's own Gradle+JUnit machinery offline against a warmed cache. Nothing in the pre-existing 837-task suite requires navigating/building a real 1.6M-LOC upstream JVM tree or running its own module tests; the largest previous codebase is 8,144 self-authored lines. Verifier runs the module's existing targeted test class (EventAccumulatorTest) plus 2 authored hidden test classes (capacity-bound semantics; per-key capacity reclaim after poll) through `:coordinator-common:test --tests ... --offline`, and asserts via git-diff that no source outside the coordinator-common module changed. Nop container scores 0: no capacity mode exists, hidden classes fail to pass, no /app/summary.md. A fresh self-contained script cannot satisfy the hidden tests: they drive the actual kafka class in the actual module build. Offline-clean verified by running the full oracle+verifier in a container launched with --network=none at 1 vCPU (reward 1) and by the nop run under verify_new_task.sh.
